Immunity: Propels the caster's turns through time, making them unbuffable, undispellable, and unactionable.
Skill Nullifier: Negates damage received from a skill once.
Barrier: Absorbs damage. Amount is proportional to specific stats.
Stealth: Cannot be targeted by Single Attacks. AoE damage is reduced by 50%.
Continuous Healing: Recovers Health at the start of the turn.
Evasion: Increases chance to evade attacks. Evaded attacks cannot crit and deal reduced damage.
Revive: Revives a dead ally with a portion of Health.
Critical Hit Resistance: Decreases chance of suffering a Critical Hit.
Sleep: Target cannot take actions. A critical hit will wake the target.
Silence: Target cannot use skills (except Basic Skill).
Provoke: Target attacks the caster with their Basic Skill.
Redirected Provoke: Target attacks the designated ally with their Basic Skill.
Burn: Deals damage at end of turn proportional to caster's Attack. Ignores Defense.
Bleeding: Deals damage at start of turn proportional to caster's Attack.
Poison: Deals damage at start of turn equal to 5% of Max Health.
Bomb: Detonates after set duration, dealing damage and stunning.
Restrict: Target cannot gain Combat Readiness from skills/artifacts.
Target: Increases damage received by 15% and decreases Evasion by 15%.
Vampiric Touch: Recovers Health of allies when attacking the target.
Venom: Deals damage proportional to Max Health and inflicts injuries.
Soulburn: Consumes Souls to enhance a skill.
Dual Attack: An ally attacks together with the caster.
Penetrates Defense: Ignores a portion of the target's Defense.
Fixed Damage: Deals a set amount of damage ignoring Defense.
Fighting Spirit: Unique resource used for special skills.
Focus: Unique resource used for special skills.
Skill Cooldown: Wait time before a skill can be used again.
Injuries: Decreases Max Health of the target.
Perception: Increases Critical Hit Chance and Critical Hit Damage.
Beguile: At the end of the turn, deals additional damage to all allies of the bearer except for the target equivalent to 10% of their respective max Health. Beguile effect applies to Heroes only, and is dispelled once the effect is activated.
Front Row: Reduces Combat Readiness gains of enemies by 50% (except Elite/Boss). Activates an AoE attack and decreases buff durations.
Power of the Archdemon: Decreases critical hit damage received (20-30%). Immune to movement-impairing debuffs.
Omen: Something is watching. Stacks up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, activates Call of the Abyss (Penetrating damage and Extinction).
Possession: Counterattacks when suffering a critical hit and recovers Health proportional to damage dealt. Cannot be dispelled.
Covenant: Immune to debuffs. If defeated while active, revives with 100% Health. (Genesis Ras)
Bind: Target cannot use movement skills (e.g. Teleport) or activate passive movement abilities.
New Phantom Sword: Enhanced Phantom Sword ability: Deals massive damage to one enemy and ignores damage sharing.
Reflect: Reflects a portion of damage received back to the attacker.
Critical Hit: A hit that deals increased damage based on Critical Damage.
Crushing Hit: A hit that deals 30% more damage but cannot Crit.
Share Damage: Damage received is shared with an ally.
